name: Ilo
description: Write, run, debug, and explain programs in ilo — a token-optimised programming language for AI agents
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `ilo` (Write, run, debug, and explain programs in ilo, a token-optimised programming language for AI agents).

Installs with `claude plugin install ilo@claude-community` from `danieljohnmorris/ilo-lang`.

*A programming language AI agents write, not humans. Named from Toki Pona for "tool".*
